# OCR startup fix closeout

PR https://github.com/npcink/npcink-ai-cloud/pull/1122 merged on 2026-10-17 09:27:24 Asia/Shanghai.

- Merge / shared-root SHA: `ea62b3f2eea225eafd72cbd55296e69e998af863`.
- Topic SHA: `9ecc3a1e2926e46a7c2adb5f34e1e6361aaa5197`.
- Shared root `/Users/muze/gitee/npcink-ai-cloud`: clean master, HEAD equals origin/master.
- L2 CI-only merge lane; runtime lane none; exact change impact `no_deploy`.

## Cause and fix

The npm launcher can start a detached auto-updater even from a version command. The updater globally reinstalls the package, creating an entry-removal window. The missing `/usr/local/bin/ocr` signature after prior successful commands is consistent with this mechanism. A replay using the exact pinned launcher and a mocked updater removal window reproduces the error; disabling the updater prevents the removal. The historical runner did not directly log the detached updater, so this is mechanism/compatibility evidence rather than a historical filesystem trace.

Set OCR_NO_UPDATE=1 at the review job level so it applies before every command in the composite action, including version/configuration. Action/CLI pins, credentials, trust, review budgets and cadence remain unchanged. Added a fresh-runner startup workflow with read-only token permissions, no checkout, no secrets, a .invalid endpoint and no model command. It verifies the pinned version before and after the failing configuration sequence and the absence of the update timestamp.

Primary launcher/updater sources:
- https://github.com/alibaba/open-code-review/blob/v1.12.13/bin/ocr.js
- https://github.com/alibaba/open-code-review/blob/v1.12.13/scripts/update.js

## Evidence

- Regression contract failed before the fix and all 3 focused contracts passed afterwards.
- Local pinned-launcher replay: auto-update enabled -> first invocation succeeds and next entry lookup fails; disabled -> 3 stable invocations with zero updater starts. No network, real global reinstall or configuration mutation in this replay.
- Ruff/format, changed Python quality, shell syntax, doc reachability and lightweight release policy passed.
- Real Linux startup check passed: https://github.com/npcink/npcink-ai-cloud/actions/runs/38990631178 . Exact OCR 1.12.13 on Ubuntu 26.04; llm.extra_body and later configuration succeeded, final version unchanged, no updater timestamp. No model call.
- Required GitHub checks passed. Cloud CI: https://github.com/npcink/npcink-ai-cloud/actions/runs/38990631063 . Contract shards: 248 + 325 + 461 = 1034 passed; impacted and static lanes passed. Skipped application/domain lanes are not claimed as executed.
- CodeQL passed: https://github.com/npcink/npcink-ai-cloud/actions/runs/38990631057 .
- Old advisory run 38990631163 used the trusted base workflow, failed with the same entry-missing error, and skipped the model-review step. No AI findings or completed AI evidence were delivered; recorded without retries. The candidate startup job, deterministic checks and five-axis source review provide the fix evidence. The merged job environment applies to subsequent review runs.
- No post-merge duplicate startup dispatch was needed: the candidate job ran the same installed pin/config sequence and the merged tree is unchanged.

## Shared local use

One machine-level OCR install/config already serves multiple repositories. Existing active provider metadata is qwen-shared. The canonical Toolbox `scripts/ocr-local.sh` entry was invoked from the Cloud repo with --preview and OCR_NO_UPDATE=1 and successfully read the shared metadata without a model request. No local credentials/config were changed or copied; no resident service was added. This proves local entry reuse, not a rollout of new policies to every repository. Hosted GitHub runners retain their separate configuration; no change to CI-versus-local review authority was made while the operator's preference question remains unanswered.

## Handoff

Zero M4 connections/operations, source transfers, image builds or production operations. No tags created/pushed/moved. The independent cloud-site-anchor-performance worktree remains present and locked; no owner files or worktrees were edited or removed by this task. Existing M4 receipts remain historical and were not rewritten.

Rollback: reviewed revert of this CI-only change; no runtime rollback.
